headline: Iran's Bank Keshavarzi Boosts Lending 58% to Near $1.1 Billion
summary: Iran's Bank Keshavarzi increased its lending by 58% year on year to 2.15 quadrillion rials (approximately $1.1 billion) during the first eight months of the Iranian year.
why: Agricultural and developmental bank lending metrics reflect credit expansion policies directed toward domestic food production sectors.

impacts.name: Iran
impacts.why: Increased bank lending expands credit availability for domestic sectors.
